data.body: AC amendment (gap-analysis F1+F2): CONTRACT CORRECTION — cde1-30ba ships a Mutation DATACLASS, not tuples. Update T2's emit to: `Mutation(direction='inbound', action='probe', target=jira_key, payload={}, provenance=<per cde1 schema>)`. Update T2's match logic: match on `mutation.direction == 'inbound' and mutation.action == 'probe'`. The 'inbound'/'probe' values must come from cde1's enum/Literal types — import them rather than hardcoding strings. T2 is HARD-BLOCKED on cde1 status=closed; sprint must NOT dispatch T2 against current open cde1.
